Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 2, 7.3, 8.1; court A. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M34JJ6YR2K714HPAPT8YTES6; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M1C2TV1SJECKEQ6SNVSRBTHQ.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own the pure extraction from cli/ModelInput and applicable Edition branches into existing shared edition code. Keep Path/file reading in the JVM adapter; use StoryModel canonical codecs/validation/companion binding. Do not invent a browser narrative schema or new top-level module.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. CLI and byte-based browser adapter agree on draft/validated disposition, derivation missing-versus-empty, feature contents and companion/sidecar refusal for identical bytes.
2. Mismatched source/build/recall/segmentation, changed sidecars and missing required roles fail; optional absence remains distinct.
3. Existing CLI edition and draft publication regressions pass. Required denied payloads cannot reach the new checked view boundary.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
CLI retains its filesystem wrapper and supported formats; shared extraction can be reverted without editing input artifacts.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Extract portable checked import policy from the CLI
